items.title: Acquittal Fuels Doubts over Transfer of Bosnian War Crimes Cases to Serbia
items.summary: While a court in Bosnia and Herzegovina has sentenced 13 people to a combined total of more than 180 years in prison for the killing of Bosniak civilians in two villages during the 1992-95 war, the acquittal of two others by a court in Belgrade has raised further doubts about the merit of transferring war crimes cases from Sarajevo to Belgrade.

items.title: Russian Despatch: Kremlin Clings to Balkan Buddies Dodik and Vucic
items.summary: Russia remains ready to aid its Balkan allies in their electoral endeavours and sabotage EU and NATO membership prospects, as Vladimir Putin’s recent efforts to boost Milorad Dodik and Aleksandar Vucic’s campaigns showed.
